messages:
rachel: Heads-up: VertexCloud marketplace deal stuck. Procurement flagged invoice PO format + missing billing codes; legal flagged a broad warranty clause. Can deal desk coordinate?
diego: What PO format do they send now?
rachel: They use `VC-INV-2026-55`. Our ERP expects `PO-######`. Also invoices lack per-line `billing_code`.
marketplace-bot: Validation error 422: invoice_schema.missing_field -> "line_items.billing_code"
priya: Legal says warranty language is too broad for open-source runtime dependencies. They want a carveout for 3rd-party OSS and limit warranty length to 90 days.
diego: Procurement needs vendor tax_id and remittance wiring too. Without those the vendor profile won't be activated.
rachel: I asked vendor to resubmit sample invoices with PO like `PO-123456` and add `billing_code` per line. Sent sample JSON.
priya: For the warranty we can accept OSS carveout + 90-day warranty but must preserve uptime SLA remedies. I'll send redline this afternoon.
diego: Vendor replied — they'll update invoice template and include billing codes in a metadata field. Will that pass validation?
marketplace-bot: Note: metadata field currently not mapped to billing_code in our parser; requesting vendor to put `billing_code` at `line_items[].billing_code`.
rachel: Asked vendor to follow exact schema and re-send. Also requested vendor tax_id and bank remittance details.
priya: If vendor agrees to warranty carveout and signs the SOW appendix, legal can clear within 48 hours.
diego: Timeline: vendor wants listing live by Friday. If they send corrected invoices today and sign appendix tomorrow, ops can flip soft-list by Friday.
rachel: I'll track on deal desk card and ping if anything misses EOD. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you complete your bit.
marketplace-bot: Ticket #MKP-8609 opened for VertexCloud onboarding validation. Assigned to vendor_integrations.
priya: Shared redline. Waiting vendor counsel response.
diego: Vendor sent one corrected invoice sample; parser still threw missing billing_code. They're adding it now.
rachel: Great — thanks. If vendor stalls we'll escalate to partnerships lead.
